title: Longitudinal federal feature derivation method, device and medium based on privacy computation
assignee: Hangzhou Bodun Xiyan Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Inefficient model training in longitudinal federal learning due to many invalid eigenvalues and high dimensionality of samples
pse.solution_function: A method for deriving longitudinal federal features based on privacy calculations that improves model training efficiency. It involves parties exchanging encrypted linear and interactive features, updating model parameters with decrypted target gradients, and determining a loss function.
pse.solution_structure: Parties (first and second), feature labels, local samples, model parameters
pse.solution_implementation: First party determines linear and interactive features from their local sample, second party does the same with their local sample and sends them. First party generates a residual error ciphertext from the first gradient, sends it to the second party who responds with a gradient ciphertext. The first party decrypts this to obtain a target data containing a second gradient. This second gradient is used to update the second model parameter.
pse.effect: Improved model training efficiency in longitudinal federal learning
